agents.name: Drift Detector
agents.role: Compute deltas and candidate drift classes

agents.name: Language Analyst
agents.role: Compare linguistic surfaces and cross-language relationships

agents.name: Attribution
agents.role: Separate observation, derivation, hypothesis and unresolved causality

agents.name: Research Demand
agents.role: Aggregate scientist interests into demand signals

agents.name: Digest & Publication
agents.role: Generate daily digest candidates and manage publication queue

deployment_principle: Logical agents may initially execute inside four worker processes; split only when scale, isolation, or reproducibility requires it.
non_goals: Do not treat an agent hypothesis as a verified finding.
Do not let public votes modify historical observations.
Do not infer causality from temporal ordering alone.
Do not auto-publish every repository commit.
